races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
races.verdict: RAYASTAR was learning on the job and surely would have been placed but for blowing the start when fourth in a 6f maiden here on debut 3 weeks ago. Looking sure to be suited by this step up in trip, he can build on that effort and come out on top. Coloursofthewind also made a promising first start when third over C&D recently and along with Jezzie Bea and Celtic Comet heads the dangers. RAYASTAR (IRE) COLOURSOFTHEWIND (IRE) JEZZIE BEA (USA)

races.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict: ROCK ON JOHNNY left his previous efforts well behind when winning on handicap debut here just 5 days ago and can defy the quick turnaround under a good-value 10-lb claimer. Mutamarid Lsk is feared most after improving since being gelded and switched to all-weather, while Hazy Sky is the type to do better in handicaps and would be of strong interest if well supported. races.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Maiden
races.verdict: STOOKED can't have been right at Roscommon last time so provided Ger Lyons' filly is ready to roll back from a 3-month break, she's fancied to go one better than on her first couple of outings in July. Otsana took a step forward when runner-up over 7f here a fortnight ago so she may emerge as the main threat, while Joseph O'Brien looks to have a strong hand and Brise Fraiche looks the best of his quartet. STOOKED (IRE) OTSANA (IRE) BRISE FRAICHE

races.verdict: GO OUT is a better performer on all-weather than turf and, with the booking of Colin Keane catching the eye, he is taken to resume winning ways in an open handicap.
